title: Tseng Kwaung Lu

Shanghai Municipal Council.
November 7th 19/8

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE DETECTIVE BRANCH）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
General Yang has received a telegram from Vice President Feng Kuo Chang saying that a prominent member of the Manchu Restoration Party named Tseng Kwaung Lu 曾廣 will arrive in Shanghai within the next few days. It is said that Tih Liang 鐵良 has given a large sum of money to Tsung to enable him to carry on monarchical propaganda in Shanghai.
General Yang has sent a telegram to the Central Government recounting the merits of Director Li Tsoong Ngoh 李宗吾 and requesting that the latter be left in his present post.
The distribution of funds and steamship tickets continued at General Li's house No.387 Avenue Edward VII yesterday when $3,238.00 and 247 passage tickets were given to 19 rebel leaders to distribute amongst 800 of their followers.
The rebel leader Loo Vung San 羅雲山 who has established an office in Room No.19 Sing Woo Li Kwan 新武里館 lodging house in Foochow Road called on the Commissioner for Foreign Affairs at 2.30 p.m. yesterday with a letter of introduction from Mr. G.Dufaure de la Prade and asked for $30,000 to disband his followers. Loo was told to forward a detailed report.

Your Obedient Servant,
MB new den. /
Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
19/8年11月7日

（印：上海工部局警务处侦探股）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：
杨将军收到副总统冯国璋的电报，称满清复辟党一名名为曾廣（Tseng Kwaung Lu）的重要成员将于数日内抵达上海。据悉，铁良（Tih Liang）已给予曾一大笔款项，以便其在上海进行君主制宣传。
杨将军已向中央政府发电，陈述李宗吾（Li Tsoong Ngoh）局长的功绩，并请求让后者留任现职。
昨日，在李将军位于爱多亚路387号的寓所内，继续分发资金和轮船票，向19名叛乱首领发放了3,238.00美元及247张船票，由他们分发给其800名追随者。
已在福州路新武里馆（Sing Woo Li Kwan）旅馆19号房间设立办事处的叛乱首领罗云山（Loo Vung San），昨日午后2时30分持G.Dufaure de la Prade先生的介绍信拜访了外交专员，索要30,000美元以遣散其追随者。罗被要求提交一份详细报告。

您顺从的仆人，
MB new den. /
侦探副督察。

警务处总巡官。

Form 2    31
Shanghai Municipal Police.
SSnza    Station.
November 8 th    1916
REPORT ON    Repatriation allowances.
Made by    Det.Insp.Fitzgibbon.    Forwarded by Inspector Kins.
Sir,
Between 1.30 & 4 p.m. on the 7 th instant General Lee Tsun Woo at 367/8 Avenue Edward VII besides distributing among 3 Anhwei & Chekiang Revolutionary Leaders a Steamer Ticket for each of 186 of their men who have already promised to leave Shanghai, he also divided a sum of $ 2166.00. among above leaders who were instructed to pay their officers & men Five & Three Dollars Each, Repatriation Allowance.
yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon
Det.Insp.
Chief Detective Inspector.
（印：椭圆形印章）

表格 2    31
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
SSnza    捕房。
1916年11月8日
关于    遣返津贴的报告。
由    侦探督察菲茨吉本（Fitzgibbon）制作。    由金斯（Kins）督察转呈。
先生：
本月7日下午1时30分至4时之间，李纯武（Lee Tsun Woo）将军在爱多亚路367/8号，除了向3名安徽和浙江革命领导人分发其麾下已承诺离开上海的186名部下的轮船票（每人一张）外，还将2,166.00美元分发给上述领导人，指示他们向其军官和士兵每人支付五美元和三美元作为遣返津贴。
您顺从的仆人，
莫里斯·菲茨吉本
侦探督察。
首席侦探督察。
（印：椭圆形印章）
